emails.subject_line_a: Quick HVAC build for A/C Mechanix
emails.body_text:
Hey Brad,

I was looking at acmechanix.com — huge respect for delivering precision residential AC replacements and load sizing across Greater Orlando since 1992.

One mobile leak caught my eye: acmechanix.com stacks 23 static form fields across the homepage with zero instant Orlando replacement ballpark or SEER2 financing range shown upfront.

So I built a working 30-second Orlando HVAC Estimator in your navy-and-cyan A/C Mechanix branding. Homeowners pick home size, system type, SEER2 tier, and ductwork for an instant local ballpark before leaving their name, phone, and address.

Mind if I send the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

linkedin_dm_touch.connection_note: Hey Brad, Big fan of A/C Mechanix in Orlando. I noticed acmechanix.com has no instant HVAC ballpark tool for mobile shoppers, so I built a working <30KB SEER2 estimator in your brand colors. Happy to send the live link — no pitch.
linkedin_dm_touch.follow_up_dm: Thanks for connecting! Here is the working Orlando HVAC replacement calculator I built for A/C Mechanix: {{preview_url}} — drops onto acmechanix.com in 5 minutes with zero redesign.

loom_60s_script.hook_0_15s: Open https://acmechanix.com/ on mobile and acknowledge A/C Mechanix's local Orlando reputation while showing the missing instant ballpark.
loom_60s_script.pain_comparison_15_35s: Contrast acmechanix.com stacks 23 static form fields across the homepage with zero instant Orlando replacement ballpark or SEER2 financing range shown upfront with how after-hours AC replacement shoppers expect a rough SEER2 and monthly payment preview.
loom_60s_script.live_demo_walkthrough_35_50s: Click through Steps 1–4 on live {{preview_url}} (3–3.5 ton Central AC + Gas Furnace 16–18 SEER2 = $9,600–$13,800, from $127/mo) and submit a sample lead with street address.
loom_60s_script.zero_pressure_cta_50_60s: Show the live trojan:lead_captured CRM webhook payload and invite Brad to drop the 1-line <30 KB script onto acmechanix.com for $750 setup + $149/mo.

objection_handlers.objection: We do not want to publish exact prices without doing a Manual-J load calculation.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Totally agree — that is why the widget intentionally displays a realistic Orlando installed range ($9,600–$13,800) with a Manual-J confirmation disclaimer so tire-kickers self-filter and serious homeowners book.

objection_handlers.objection: We already use ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or our own contact form.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: This drops right alongside your existing stack and fires a clean JSON webhook (tonnage, system type, SEER2 tier, ductwork, and street address) directly into your dispatch inbox, SMS, or CRM.

objection_handlers.objection: Will adding a calculator slow down our site or break our theme?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero external libraries and under 30 KB of pure Shadow DOM vanilla JS — installs with one script tag in 5 minutes and cannot conflict with existing CSS or hurt Core Web Vitals.

objection_handlers.objection: Why is there a $149/mo retainer after the $750 setup?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: It covers global Cloudflare edge hosting, instant lead routing uptime, and quarterly SEER2 equipment/financing price updates whenever distributor costs shift — a single extra system replacement pays for years of it.
